info.description: This is the API for balade, a diagnostic for enterpreneurs.
info.title: balade API

post.description: Authenticate a user by sending a unique code

get.description: Search users by email or name (admin only)
Get all guides with optional active filter
Get the guide profile linked to the authenticated user

put.description: Update the guide profile linked to the authenticated user
Update payment configuration for the guide linked to the authenticated user
put.summary: Update payment configuration for the current guide

put.description: Update an existing guide with the provided data

delete.description: Delete a guide by its ID

post.description: Link an existing guide profile to a user and grant the guide role
post.summary: Link a guide to a user account

put.description: Update payment configuration for a guide including Stripe credentials
put.summary: Update payment configuration for a guide

post.description: Handle Stripe webhook events for payment processing

get.description: Get payment details by ID, for the booker of its reservation or authorized staff

post.description: Process a refund for a payment (refund:payments or manage:payments)

get.description: Get all rambles with optional filters

parameters.description: Search in title, description, or location
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Filter rambles from this date (RFC3339 format)
parameters.name: date_from

parameters.description: Filter rambles to this date (RFC3339 format)
parameters.name: date_to

parameters.description: Filter rambles by specific guide ID
parameters.name: guide_id

parameters.description: Include unpublished rambles (requires create:ramble or update:ramble permission)
parameters.name: include_unpublished

put.description: Update an existing ramble with the provided data

delete.description: Delete a ramble by its ID

put.description: Cancel a ramble with a reason

post.description: Create a copy of an existing ramble with a new date. The copy starts as an unpublished draft.

get.description: Get the reservations of the authenticated booker, with participants, prices, status, estimated amount and payments

post.description: Reserve a ramble for one or more participants. Public: the booker's account is found or created from the contact email.

get.description: Get the reservations with their participants, with filtering and pagination (admin or guide)

parameters.description: Status: pending, confirmed, waiting_list or cancelled
parameters.name: status

post.description: Confirm, cancel, move to waiting list or delete several reservations. Each one follows the rules of the single actions, and fails separately.

delete.description: Delete a reservation with its participants. The places it held go to the waiting list, and its open payments are cancelled.

put.description: Change the name or the price of a participant, to correct an error. The omitted fields are kept. Once the reservation is paid, the known prices are frozen but the name can still be corrected and a missing price specified.
put.summary: Update a participant of a reservation (admin)

put.description: Set the status of a reservation, as a whole. A reservation put back in pending, confirmed or waiting list from a status that holds no place must fit entirely in the places left. The places released go to the waiting list.

get.description: Get a reservation, for its booker or an admin or guide allowed to view the ramble's registrations

put.description: Cancel the whole reservation. The places released go to the waiting list. No automatic refund: has_successful_payment tells that the booker should contact the guide.

Confirm a pending reservation, for its booker only, from 3 days before the ramble until the confirmation deadline 12 hours before. When online payment is enabled, payment holds the payment of the amount due, computed from the participants' prices. On a confirmed reservation, it gives the payment of the balance until the ramble starts.

409.description: missing_prices, reservation_waiting_list, reservation_cancelled, ramble_cancelled, confirmation_not_open, confirmation_deadline_passed or ramble_started

post.description: Add participants, until the ramble starts, to a pending or confirmed reservation if they all fit in the places left, or to a reservation in waiting list. Participants added to a confirmed reservation are confirmed, and payment holds the complementary payment of their prices when online payment is enabled. When the payment cannot be prepared, the participants stay added and payment_unavailable is true: the complement is paid later through the confirmation. The booker receives a summary email.

put.description: Change the name or the price of a participant, as long as the reservation is not paid. Once paid, only a missing price (price_missing) can still be specified.
put.summary: Update a participant of a reservation

delete.description: Remove a participant. Removing the last one cancels the reservation. The places released go to the waiting list. has_successful_payment tells that the booker should contact the guide for a refund.
delete.summary: Remove a participant from a reservation

send_email.description: Whether to send the reservation summary to the booker
Whether to send the reservation summary to the bookers

reason.description: machine-readable business error, for clients to react to

stripe_account_id.description: Payment configuration (sensitive fields excluded for security)

price_amount.description: PriceAmount is the amount in euros of the participant's price, 0 when the price is missing.

price_missing.description:
PriceMissing tells that the ramble has prices but the participant's is
unknown, as for participants migrated from a ramble with several prices.

amount.description: Amount to refund in cents, if nil refunds full amount

max_participants_per_reservation.description: MaxParticipantsPerReservation is the capacity, or a safeguard when the ramble is unlimited.

amount_due.description: AmountDue is the amount in cents left to pay: EstimatedAmount minus AmountPaid, never below zero.

amount_paid.description: AmountPaid is the amount in cents paid and kept: the payments succeeded minus their refunds.

estimated_amount.description: EstimatedAmount is the amount in cents computed from the participants' known prices.

has_missing_prices.description:
HasMissingPrices tells that a participant's price is unknown, so that
EstimatedAmount is incomplete.

has_successful_payment.description:
HasSuccessfulPayment tells that an amount paid is kept (a payment succeeded
and not entirely refunded): after a removal or a cancellation, the booker
is invited to contact the guide for a refund.

status.description: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed, cancelled, partially_refunded, refunded

amount_due.description: AmountDue is the amount in cents left to pay: EstimatedAmount minus AmountPaid, never below zero.

amount_paid.description: AmountPaid is the amount in cents paid and kept: the payments succeeded minus their refunds.

estimated_amount.description: EstimatedAmount is the amount in cents computed from the participants' known prices.

has_missing_prices.description:
HasMissingPrices tells that a participant's price is unknown, so that
EstimatedAmount is incomplete.

has_successful_payment.description:
HasSuccessfulPayment tells that an amount paid is kept (a payment succeeded
and not entirely refunded): after a removal or a cancellation, the booker
is invited to contact the guide for a refund.

payment_unavailable.description:
PaymentUnavailable tells that the change is saved but the payment could not
be prepared: it is to be made later, by confirming the reservation again.
